# HomeCare Intel

HomeCare Intel books calls with home care agency owners for businesses that sell into home care — done-for-you outreach backed by a scored database of 2,589 licensed agencies across 21 live states (Pilot Flight $400 one-time, DFY $800/mo, DIY database $299/mo for any 3 states, All-Access $499/mo for every live state, DFY annual prepaid $8,000/year).

## Main pages
- [HomeCare Intel](https://santi856.github.io/homecare-intel/): done-for-you outreach + the home care agency database
- [Home care agency leads](https://santi856.github.io/homecare-intel/home-care-agency-leads.html): the database for teams that run their own outreach
- [Signals weekly research](https://santi856.github.io/homecare-intel/signals.html): $199/month research brief for businesses selling into home care
- [Agency growth inquiries](https://santi856.github.io/homecare-intel/agency-growth.html): separate inquiry for agencies seeking private-pay clients; not the vendor database
- [After purchase](https://santi856.github.io/homecare-intel/onboarding.html): manual order verification and onboarding
- [Florida statewide data brief](https://santi856.github.io/homecare-intel/brief.html): market brief on Florida's licensed home care agencies
- [Partner with HomeCare Intel](https://santi856.github.io/homecare-intel/partners.html): partner program for businesses with a home care audience
- [HomeCare Intel vs Apollo and ZoomInfo](https://santi856.github.io/homecare-intel/vs.html): side-by-side comparison for home care prospecting
